ZapIME / 闪电输入法 0.1.0-dev

This is a modified product built with the MSIME engine, not an official MSIME release.
MSIME: https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime
Pinned source: 97d652a49cabb0887355b84186af2aa9032d3814
MSIME copyright belongs to its respective contributors; GPL-3.0-only.
ZapIME's independent Android host and session adapter were added on 2026-10-20.
ZapIME Apple development hosts and the bounded C ABI were added on 2026-10-22.
The Apple hosts reference the pinned MSIME native lifecycle and extension configuration;
the engine and required upstream and dependency notices remain included.
Corresponding source, build scripts and license texts must accompany binary distribution.

The engine includes chinese-ime-lm reference/ (Apache-2.0).
See licenses/chinese-ime-lm-NOTICE.txt and licenses/chinese-ime-lm-Apache-2.0.txt.
This development package does not bundle neural model weights, n-gram files,
third-party cloud services, or unlicensed dictionary inputs.

Android includes the fixed MSIME shared/voice/LocalAsr.cpp implementation (GPL-3.0-only)
and sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 / ONNX Runtime native CPU libraries. Artifact and per-library
hashes plus source identity are in android-voice-lock.json. The AAR has no notices;
Sherpa Apache-2.0, ONNX MIT/ThirdPartyNotices, nlohmann-json MIT and NDK notices
are copied into assets/voice-licenses. Model weights are not bundled. This native
bridge alone is not microphone or voice-input UI acceptance.

Pinyin and English dictionaries: metasequoiaime/msime-dictionary dict-v2.0.24.
Their manifest states includes_unlicensed_inputs=false. rime-ice (GPL-3.0),
ECDICT (MIT), SCOWL (permissive notices), and other resource notices remain
in assets/licenses and assets/dictionary/msime-scowl_Copyright.txt.
See licenses/msime-engine-dictionary-NOTICE.md for source attribution.
All embedded engine resource and dependency licenses are retained.

On 2026-10-23 ZapIME adapted the pinned MSIME SelectionEchoTracker.java and
SelectionEchoTrackerSmoke.java (GPL-3.0-only, respective MSIME contributors).
Original comments and tests are retained; package/imports and Math bounds helpers
were adapted. Upstream source paths and exact commit are in docs/LICENSE_AUDIT.md.
The upstream repository and GPL text remain available with corresponding source.

ZapIME also adapts the same pinned MSIMEInputService.java marker-loss/restart
handoff helpers (GPL-3.0-only, MSIME contributors), modified on 2026-10-23.
The bounded asynchronous decoder reset and initial-snapshot check are ZapIME adaptations.
